svg.title: Exhibit B — Connected Phone Forensics
svg.desc: Exhibit B: Connected Phone Forensics (Python · Windows · macOS · Linux · PyPI). Find every phone that was connected to a computer, what it left there, and exactly where each fact came from. 23 parsers, 8 connection types, 3 host platforms, SHA-256 every file read.
svg.text: Find every phone that was connected to a computer, what it left there, and
exactly where each fact came from.
